record.oneLiner: An Early Cretaceous nodosaur with long neck spines.
record.description: Sauropelta was a nodosaurid — an armoured dinosaur without a tail club — of Early Cretaceous North America, about 5–6 m long. It carried extensive bony armour and large spines projecting from its neck, and had an unusually long tail.

notableFacts.text: Bore large defensive spines projecting from its neck.
Its long tail made up about half its body length — but had no club.
